page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.20xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.4 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

In terms of connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Because it lacks local storage, all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The high core count combined with a relatively lean memory allocation makes this instance highly cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints per thread.

Appropriate workloads for the ecs.hfc6.20xlarge include high-performance computing (HPC), batch processing, intensive web serving, and distributed analytics where CPU execution speed and parallel processing capacity are the primary bottlenecks.
